main_issue: Who will cover Agent D's unfinished analysis section for Thursday's pitch while D is away for the funeral, given B and C say they lack capacity

A-B.evidence: B objects to A volunteering them (T4-6, T11, T14: 'Looking won't change my workload'); A shifts to offering to do the analysis himself (T15) and B never agrees to help.

A-C.evidence: C refuses extra work (T7, T12), but A proposes splitting analysis from other parts (T15) and C says 'We can look' (T16); both then join D's walkthrough.

A-D.evidence: A tells D not to worry (T3); D offers a walkthrough (T17), A thanks D and they do it together (T18, T27-30).

B-C.evidence: C backs B ('He's right', T7) and both resist taking on more; C later softens slightly to look (T16) while B stays firm.

B-D.evidence: B never addresses D or takes a position on D's walkthrough; B stops speaking after T14.

C-D.evidence: C says they don't know how to do D's analysis (T12) and agrees to look (T16); D offers a walkthrough to everyone (T17), with no direct exchange.
